title: Cosanima rename: apg → cosanima (brand, binary, layout, tooling, distribution)
goal: Rename the product, binary, package, data layout, tool suite, agents, and distribution artifacts from `apg` to `cosanima` pre-1.0 — the cheapest possible rename moment, before a real install base turns it into a migration story.

title: Package + binary renamed to cosanima
body: Cargo.toml `package.name` apg → cosanima and `[[bin]]` name apg → cosanima (path stays src/main.rs). The published binary is `cosanima`: `cosanima init`, `cosanima scan`, `cosanima query`, `cosanima spec/plan/review`. The Rust crate rename re-roots the ingestor's module FQNs from apg.* to cosanima.*, so in-repo references and graph-derived names follow.

title: CLI help/version identifies cosanima
body: CLI usage/version/help output identifies the tool as cosanima: `cosanima --help` lists cosanima subcommands and the crate description; `print_help` strings (src/main.rs ~500-534) and error/usage messages no longer say `apg`. `cosanima --version` reports 1.0.0 (version value is gated by the parent release spec).

title: Data dir apg/ → .cosanima/
body: Move the repo-local data dir `apg/` → `.cosanima/`: committed config at `.cosanima/config.json`, transient state at `.cosanima/.trans/` (db.lbug, graph.jsonl, plans, apg-frontend.log → cosanima-frontend.log). Root discovery walks up for a `.cosanima` dir. Existing `apg.find_apg_root` / `apg.find_or_create_apg_root` / `apg.is_apg_source_dir` semantics follow the new dir name.

title: Crate/module FQN root ripple swept
body: Because the ingestor renders module FQNs from the crate/package name, renaming the crate re-roots every apg.* Rust module/function FQN to cosanima.*. This requirement is the internal-reference sweep: update in-code doc comments, module paths, and graph-derived references across src/*.rs so nothing still points at apg.*.

title: .gitignore scaffolding updated
body: `cosanima init` scaffolds `.cosanima/.trans/` into the repo `.gitignore` (replacing the `apg/.trans/` line it writes today, src/main.rs ~793-813). The rename sweep also removes any stale `apg/.trans/` entries from existing repos so transient state is consistently gitignored under the new dir.

title: Transient artifact + env names renamed
body: Transient artifact names move with the rename: db.lbug and graph.jsonl land in `.cosanima/.trans/`, the run log is `cosanima-frontend.log` (was apg-frontend.log), and the frontend-dir env override is `COSANIMA_FRONTEND_DIR` (was APG_FRONTEND_DIR, src/main.rs ~318-338). Frontend resolution order (env → exe-dir → libexec) is unchanged.

title: Spec/note/plan JSONL roots move
body: The committed spec/note/plan JSONL roots relocate with the data-dir change: `apg/specs/*.jsonl`, `apg/notes/<module>.jsonl`, and transient plans move under `.cosanima/` (`.cosanima/specs`, `.cosanima/notes`, `.cosanima/.trans/plans`). Spec discovery, write-through, and plan retirement all follow the new root (src/specs.rs, artifacts.rs).

title: README + docs sweep
body: In-repo documentation and example sweep: README.md, AGENTS.md, SPEC-*.md, and install.sh use `cosanima` (commands `cosanima scan`, dir `.cosanima/`) with no live `apg` command/binary references remaining. Historical/changelog mentions of the old name are allowed; every *live* instruction reads cosanima.

summary: Rename now, pre-1.0: the install base is tiny and nothing depends on `apg` yet, so this is the cheapest possible rename moment — the same rename becomes a migration story post-1.0 (source SPEC-1.0.0.md 'This is the cheapest rename moment').

body: No `apg` alias or backward-compatibility shim: at 1.0.0 the old binary name and apg_* tool prefixes are gone (a clean cut, not a transitional alias).

No on-disk format change during the rename: db.lbug / graph.jsonl byte content is unchanged — only paths, env var, and log names move. Schema/format churn belongs to the versioned frontend contract (cosanima-frontend-interface), not here.
No repo-topology change here: the monorepo → core + six frontend repo split is cosanima-repo-split's scope, not the rename's.
No license change here: the MIT → Apache-2.0 migration is cosanima-license's scope; this project only renames.
`cosanima --version` and `cosanima --help` succeed and identify cosanima (no `apg` binary is produced by `cargo build`).
A fresh `cosanima init` in a clean temp repo scaffolds a `.cosanima/.trans/` gitignore entry and installs cosanima_* tools + six agents into ~/.opencode, writing no apg_* file.
`cosanima scan` on this repo writes `.cosanima/.trans/db.lbug` + graph.jsonl and `cosanima query` returns rows against it.
A `rg` sweep for live `apg`/`apg_` references over README.md, AGENTS.md, src/main.rs, install.sh, Formula/, and .opencode/ returns only historical/changelog mentions (no current instructions).
`cargo build` produces the cosanima binary and `cosanima --help` lists the cosanima subcommands.
End-to-end smoke on a clean machine path: `cosanima init` → `cosanima scan` → `cosanima query` on a representative repo completes under the .cosanima layout.

The rename is load-bearing because `apg` ("a program graph") no longer describes what the project does — it graphs the active knowledge that drives a program (code + intent/why + trajectory/what's-next as native nodes in the same graph). The "graph" framing is exactly what the rename leaves behind (source SPEC-1.0.0.md, Positioning + Name).

Old → new mapping: Cargo.toml package/bin apg→cosanima; dir `apg/`→`.cosanima/`; `.trans`; log apg-frontend.log→cosanima-frontend.log; env APG_FRONTEND_DIR→COSANIMA_FRONTEND_DIR; tool suite apg_*→cosanima_* (46 tools) + lib/apg.ts→cosanima.ts; agent prefixes; tap antz29/apg→antz29/cosanima; formulae apg-*/scanner→cosanima-*/cosanima; spec JSONL roots apg/specs→.cosanima/specs.

The name/map metaphor is the one to lead with (a map you navigate, not a graph data structure); the cost of renaming grows with the install base, and 1.0 has a deliberately small one, so the cut is cheapest now.

source: SPEC-1.0.0.md uses the working placeholder `carto` (carto scan, carto init, SUPPORTED_CARTO, carto frontend validate, tap/cartoa etc.) and `anima` as the leading name candidate; the binding design decision is Cosanima. This child project (and all cosanima-* children + the parent) materialize every carto/anima occurrence as the cosanima equivalent: cosanima scan, SUPPORTED_COSANIMA, cosanima frontend validate [with user].

title: Tap, formulae, installers renamed
body: Distribution artifacts are renamed: brew tap `antz29/apg` → `really-knows-ai/cosanima` (the tap owner moves from antz29 to the really-knows-ai org), `scanner.rb` + the six `apg-<lang>.rb` formulae → `cosanima.rb` + `cosanima-<lang>.rb`; the curl installer `install.sh` headers/examples and the linux-release package names (`apg-linux-*.tar.gz` → `cosanima-linux-*.tar.gz`, `sha256sums.txt`) follow. In-binary help strings that reference `brew install antz29/apg/apg-go` (src/main.rs ~941) are updated to `brew install really-knows-ai/cosanima/cosanima-<lang>`.

source: R11 mapped the brew tap `antz29/apg` → `antz29/cosanima` and kept the in-binary help string `brew install antz29/apg/apg-go` (owner org antz29); the binding org decision places every repo AND the brew tap under really-knows-ai; resolution: R11 now reads tap `antz29/apg` → `really-knows-ai/cosanima` and the install help `brew install really-knows-ai/cosanima/cosanima-<lang>`; formula rename (scanner.rb/apg-<lang>.rb → cosanima.rb/cosanima-<lang>.rb) is unchanged [with user].

source: note-2's old → new mapping listed `tap antz29/apg → antz29/cosanima`; the binding org decision moves the tap under really-knows-ai, so that mapping line is superseded: `tap antz29/apg → really-knows-ai/cosanima` (tap short name cosanima, owner really-knows-ai), install string `brew install really-knows-ai/cosanima/cosanima-<lang>` [with user].

summary: Full prefix sweep, no back-compat shims: every apg_* tool/agent prefix and the `apg` command become cosanima_*/cosanima with no alias or `apg` compatibility shim — 1.0 is a clean cut on the new name. User-confirmed [with user].

body: confirmation: the user confirmed the ruling that the rename is a clean cut — every apg_* tool/agent prefix and the `apg` command become cosanima_*/cosanima with no alias or compatibility shim. resolution: D2 substance unchanged; now marked user-confirmed [with user].

title: Tool suite retired — MCP server replaces the opencode tools
body: The opencode tool suite is RETIRED, not renamed: the 46 `.opencode/tools/apg_*.ts` tool scripts and the shared plumbing `.opencode/lib/apg.ts` are no longer shipped in any form (no cosanima_* rename of the scripts). The local MCP server (cosanima-mcp) replaces them — the same operations are exposed as MCP tools. The embedded `include_str!` tool lists in src/main.rs (lines ~28-215) are removed/repurposed accordingly. (Superseded by cosanima-mcp, Decision D2 — this requirement no longer performs a prefix sweep of the tool suite.)

title: Agent prefix apg_ → cosanima_ (cross-harness agents from cosanima-mcp)
body: The six distributed agents (codebase-navigator, spec-writer, plan-writer, spec-review, plan-review, agent-builder) still exist but are now the CROSS-HARNESS artifacts from cosanima-mcp: canonical markdown + YAML frontmatter, rendered per harness by the frontmatter adapter, referencing the shared MCP tool names. This requirement is the prefix sweep apg_ → cosanima_ applied to the agent names (agent FQNs/headers and the agent-builder scaffolding strings) — it does NOT sweep tool-suite prefixes (the tool suite is retired, see R8); the agents' internal tool references point at the MCP tool names per cosanima-mcp. (Superseded in substance by cosanima-mcp's cross-harness agents; single-sourced form moves from .opencode/agents/*.md + include_str! embedding in src/main.rs ~222-247 to the canonical form.)

title: Init installs MCP server + cross-harness agents; legacy cleanup unchanged
body: `cosanima init` now installs the local MCP server + the cross-harness agent artifacts (from cosanima-mcp) into the harness/user config locations instead of the opencode tool suite + lib + six agents into `~/.opencode/`. Legacy cleanup still applies unchanged: it purges `apg_*`-named user tools/agents it no longer owns and any pre-`~/.opencode` project-local `.opencode/` install (existing remove_legacy_project_install logic, src/main.rs ~620-695, extended to also drop apg-named user tools). (Superseded in install-behavior by cosanima-mcp R13.)

source: R8 'Tool-suite prefix apg_* → cosanima_*' renamed all 46 `.opencode/tools/apg_*.ts` scripts and lib/apg.ts → cosanima.ts. inconsistency: the binding architecture decision replaces the custom opencode tool-suite layer with a local MCP server (cosanima-mcp) — the tools are RETIRED, not renamed, so R8's rename action no longer applies. resolution: R8 rephrased to retire the tool suite (no cosanima_* scripts are produced); the MCP server replaces it; the include_str! tool lists in src/main.rs ~28-215 are removed/repurposed; R8's old action is superseded by cosanima-mcp D2/R12 [with user].

source: R9 'Agent prefix apg_ → cosanima_' swept the six agents' prefixes and every internal tool-name reference to the apg_* suite, keeping them single-sourced in `.opencode/agents/*.md` embedded via include_str!. inconsistency: agents still exist, but the MCP decision makes them canonical markdown+frontmatter artifacts from cosanima-mcp referencing shared MCP tool names — the 'internal tool-name references to apg_*' part of the sweep is obsolete (the apg_* suite is retired). resolution: R9 rephrased — the six agents ARE the cross-harness artifacts from cosanima-mcp (canonical form + MCP tools); the apg_ → cosanima_ prefix sweep still applies to the agent names; the tool-reference sweep is dropped (superseded by cosanima-mcp R9/R11) [with user].

source: R10 'Init install + legacy cleanup converge on cosanima' had `cosanima init` install the cosanima_* tool suite + lib + six agents into `~/.opencode/`. inconsistency: with the tool suite retired, there is no cosanima_* tool suite for init to install — the MCP decision changes what init installs. resolution: R10 rephrased — `cosanima init` installs the MCP server + cross-harness agents (from cosanima-mcp) instead of the opencode tool suite; the legacy cleanup of apg-named artifacts (remove_legacy_project_install, src/main.rs ~620-695) still applies; install behavior is superseded by cosanima-mcp R13 [with user].
